description: This file defines the SlidingTabLayout class, a custom view component for Android that provides a tab indicator synchronized with a ViewPager, allowing users to navigate between pages with visual feedback. It includes interfaces for customizing tab colors and methods for setting up the view with a ViewPager, creating tab views, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom HorizontalScrollView that displays tabs linked to a ViewPager, providing visual feedback on scroll progress and allowing tab customization.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface for customizing indicator and divider colors for tabs.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom colorizer for tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Defines colors for the selected tab indicator, treated as a circular array.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Defines colors for tab dividers, treated as a circular array.

methods.name: setOnPageChangeListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for ViewPager page change events.

methods.name: setCustomTabView
methods.description: Sets a custom layout for tab views, specifying layout and TextView IDs.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Associates a ViewPager with the tab layout and populates tabs based on its adapter.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView for tabs if no custom layout is provided.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Creates and adds tab views to the tab strip based on the ViewPager's adapter.

methods.name: scrollToTab
methods.description: Scrolls the tab strip to make the specified tab visible, with optional offset.
